Hint.Override: To change an existing macro, you must return its source, identifier and rules. Your entry replaces every pass of that macro.

Welcome.Title: Coven's Automation Toolkit
Welcome.Content:
Coven's Automation Toolkit applies and configures automations from modules such as Cauldron of Plentiful Resources.

For help, check the FAQ channel in the Coven's Discord, then ask in #support with the Troubleshooter export.

Join the Coven's Discord

Guided tours

catkit.Title: Applying Automations
catkit.Description: Apply and configure automations with the CatKit.

intro.Title: The CatKit
intro.Content: Every automation is applied and configured from the CatKit.

sheetControl.Title: Opening the CatKit
sheetControl.Content: The CatKit opens from the shield icon in a sheet's controls menu.

status.Title: Automation Status
status.Content: The shield's color shows the automation status. Yellow: available. Red: update available. Green: up to date. Blue: up to date, with options. Pink: the chosen source has no automation for this item.

apply.Title: Apply an Automation
apply.Content: Pick a source and click the check mark to replace the item with the automated version.

rules.Title: Rules Version
rules.Content: Set the rules version that matches the item before applying.

identifier.Title: Identifier
identifier.Content: Automations are matched by identifier. If the CatKit finds nothing, check that the identifier matches the item's name.

source.Title: Automation Source
source.Content: Pick a module here to override the Automation Sources order for this item.

tabs.Title: Other Tabs
tabs.Content: Configuration holds the automation's options. The other tabs are for building your own.

troubleshooter.Title: Troubleshooter
troubleshooter.Content: The stethoscope opens the Troubleshooter. Attach its export when asking for help.

actor.Title: Whole Actors
actor.Content: Mass Apply / Update automates every item on the actor at once.

compendium.Title: Whole Compendiums
compendium.Content: A compendium's CatKit automates every item in it. Locked compendiums are copied first.

outro.Title: Done
outro.Content: Next, set up your automation sources.

intro.Title: Automation Sources
intro.Content: Automation sources decide which modules the CatKit uses, and which one takes priority.

open.Title: Opening the List
open.Content: The list opens from Configure Automation Sources.

order.Title: Priority Order
order.Content: Put Cauldron of Plentiful Resources first, then Gambit's Premades and Midi Item Showcase if you use them, and Midi-QOL's sample items last.

content.Title: Automations, Not Content
content.Content: Leave D&D Beyond Importer, the system and sourcebook modules disabled here.

kinds.Title: Sources and Compendiums
kinds.Content: Blue Source rows are modules. Gold Compendium rows are single compendiums, for automations you made yourself.

rank.Title: Reordering
rank.Content: Drag a row or type a rank. Lower ranks come first.

inactive.Title: Inactive Sources
inactive.Content: Disabled sources wait here. The + button adds one back.

confirm.Title: Saving
confirm.Content: Confirm saves the list. Applied items keep their automation until you update them.

compendiums.Title: Compendiums
compendiums.Content: Compendiums is a separate list of where to find complete documents, such as spells a feature adds.

compendiumLists.Title: Compendium Lists
compendiumLists.Content: List compendiums with full content, top first. For the system or a sourcebook, automate a copy with its CatKit and list the copy.

reapply.Title: Fixing Applied Items
reapply.Content: Items applied from the wrong source keep it. Pick the right source in the item's CatKit and apply it again.

settings.Title: CAT Settings
settings.Description: A tour of CAT's settings menus.

intro.Title: CAT Settings
intro.Content: Cauldron of Plentiful Resources has no settings of its own. Its options live here.

help.Title: Troubleshooter
help.Content: The Troubleshooter finds and fixes setting conflicts. Attach its export when asking for help.

automation.Title: Automation Sources
automation.Content: Automation Sources has its own tour.

backups.Title: Backups
backups.Content: Backups saves player characters to a compendium on a schedule.

compendiums.Title: Compendiums
compendiums.Content: Compendiums lists where your complete documents are stored.

integration.Title: Integration
integration.Content: Integration covers Dice So Nice and animation modules.

manualRolls.Title: Manual Rolls
manualRolls.Content: Manual Rolls sets up the roll resolver for physical dice.

mechanics.Title: Mechanics
mechanics.Content: Mechanics holds rules automation, such as recharge rolls.

permissions.Title: Permissions
permissions.Content: Permissions sets which users can open each CatKit tab.

devtools.Title: Development Tools
devtools.Content: Development Tools are for macro writers. Keep them off during play.
